content: {"episode_id":"ep-05100","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93226, the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, which the payer letter states is not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication documents a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia (I48.91, I49.9) with persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) that interfere with daily activities. The 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances. Given this documented indication, we request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 164.15."}
